title: valeriana dioica subsp. simplicifolia
intro: Valeriana dioica subsp. simplicifolia, commonly known as a type of Valerian, is a flowering plant in the family Valerianaceae. It has been used for its various health benefits, including improving sleep quality, reducing anxiety and stress, and acting as a natural sedative due to its calming effects. The therapeutic actions of Valeriana dioica subsp. simplicifolia include its ability to act as a nervine relaxant, sedative, and anxiolytic agent, making it useful for treating restlessness, insomnia, and other sleep disorders. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as valepotriates, valerenic acids, and isovalerenic acid, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
